component.name: com.hyland.openarch.ecm.core.event.raise.DocumentEventRaiserService
component.documentation: Central service responsible for raising different document modification events (e.g. DOCUMENT_UPDATED, DOCUMENT_BLOB_MODIFIED) through pluggable DocumentEventRaiser contributions. Each raiser is bound to an event name; when a raise is requested the service dispatches to the raiser that supports that event.

extension-point.name: raisers
extension-point.documentation: Register a com.hyland.openarch.ecm.core.event.raise.DocumentEventRaiser bound to a document event name to customize how that event is raised.
